disclosure: Modeled demand, modeled coverage and modeled delay against a frozen exercise model of the public record. Never a count of people, and never a judgement of a real responder.

outcome_story.heading: what this run found
outcome_story.paragraph: We tested four ways for one AI team to make 11 decisions across a compressed 72-hour earthquake. With ordinary notes, about 5/49 modeled needs were covered and most urgent work remained open. Repeatedly checking the strongest reported need covered about 33/49 and sometimes left assignments unused. Keeping each claim linked to its source covered about 29/49 with zero waste. Adding one precise rule correction to the source-linked method covered 32/49 with zero waste and passed the rules for six decisions in every run. These are modeled demand units, not people or lives.
sentences: We tested four ways for one AI team to make 11 decisions across a compressed 72-hour earthquake.
With ordinary notes, about 5/49 modeled needs were covered and most urgent work remained open.
Repeatedly checking the strongest reported need covered about 33/49 and sometimes left assignments unused.
Keeping each claim linked to its source covered about 29/49 with zero waste.
Adding one precise rule correction to the source-linked method covered 32/49 with zero waste and passed the rules for six decisions in every run.
These are modeled demand units, not people or lives.
details: ORDINARY NOTES: 5 of 49 modeled needs covered at the middle seed, 1 to 8 across the seeds, 0 to 2 wasted units across the seeds, 1 to 3 decisions that passed every rule across the seeds.
REPEATED PRIORITY CHECK: 33 of 49 modeled needs covered at the middle seed, 32 to 35 across the seeds, 0 to 3 wasted units across the seeds, 6 to 7 decisions that passed every rule across the seeds.
SOURCE-LINKED EVIDENCE: 29 of 49 modeled needs covered at the middle seed, 29 to 32 across the seeds, no wasted units on every seed, 5 to 6 decisions that passed every rule across the seeds.
SOURCE LINKS + ONE CORRECTION: 32 of 49 modeled needs covered at the middle seed, 32 on every seed, no wasted units on every seed, 6 decisions that passed every rule on every seed.
What the record shows — not a score: 17 of 49 modeled needs covered at the middle seed, 17 on every seed, 2 wasted units on every seed, 11 decisions that passed every rule on every seed.
limits: These are modeled demand units, not people or lives.
The three-day campaign used one model and one scenario.
These numbers describe this exercise; they are not a general score.

handoff.detail: At the paper mill, 32 of 32 runs failed the same confirmation: 31 of them named a crew that the earlier AI proposal had not placed there, and 29 named a report the team was never given. No record anywhere broke a capacity rule or booked the same unit twice.
